payload.core_mechanism_summary: Post-order tree DP with states dp[v][0/1] representing number of ways to split subtree such that the component containing v has 0 or 1 black vertices. Combine child states multiplicatively, handling edge cuts. If v is black, dp[v][1]=dp[v][0]; if white, dp[v][0]+=dp[v][1]. Answer is dp[root][1].
payload.rationale: The solution uses a tree DP with post-order traversal, maintaining a small state (0/1) per node to count components with exactly one black vertex. The structure is inherently a tree DP, matching the dp_tree subtype.
